messages:
hana: FYI staging builds started spitting up a bunch of broken jumps after the markdown formatter update. saw failures pointing to anchors like `#service-quotas` on /platform/limits
omar: paste the linkcheck output please
hana: snippet:
```
WARNING - 404: /platform/limits/#service-quotas
WARNING - The page 'guides/ops/quotas.md' contains a broken reference to 'platform/limits/#service-quotas'
```
rachel: quick grep shows the heading on /platform/limits is `Service‑quotas` (note the unicode figure dash). new formatter left the dash as is when generating the id, but our link rewrite expects plain `-`. mismatch.
omar: simple fix: add a normalizer that converts a set of common unicode punctuation to ASCII before slugify. also add a diagnostic mode that lists suspect files.
hana: can we also add a harmless redirect rule so both slugs work during rollout? that would avoid an emergency revert.
migra-bot: suggested migration command: `tools/regen-links --diagnose --apply-redirects`
omar: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/612 — includes slug normalizer, a small redirect map, and a test harness for headings.
rachel: reviewed and left a nit about the regex. also requested an extra case for non-breaking spaces.
omar: addressed and pushed. CI green.
build-bot: Deploy job #912 started for nightly with anchor-compat plugin enabled.
hana: running a quick linkcheck on staging now. looks clean; only one remaining warning in fr locale where heading ends with an ellipsis. adding ticket DOCS-421 to sweep trailing punctuation.
rachel: adding a short note to MIGRATION.md reminding folks to run `tools/regen-links` after changing headings or running the formatter.
hana: thanks all ":)""
